officialTitle: Driving AI adoption above targets in highly regulated environment

chapters.title: Introduction: AI adoption in a regulated company
Working with regulation and customer contracts
Curating tools and managing token budgets
A live, secure shared context and feedback loops
Key lessons: security, people and practical guidance
Leadership direction: stay the course and adapt

existingSummary: Jussi Hacklin describes Elisa’s AI adoption journey in a regulated environment. He explains how legal collaboration, clear guidance, shared tools, developer communities and bounded experiments support adoption, then discusses live shared context and the leadership needed as the development process changes.
